guidance.text: Migrations are append-only and checksummed. Add a new migration; never edit an applied one. Read docs/data.md.
A command change needs: an entry in ipc/catalogue.rs, the bridge method in src/renderer/lib/tauriBridge.ts, a line in remote/dispatch.rs, then npm run generate:contracts. Read docs/ipc.md.
Read docs/data.md. SQL stays in this directory.
A turn ends only through commit_turn_end in session_service_turn_end.rs. Read docs/runtime.md.
Read docs/providers.md. Provider bypass flags stay in adapters.rs.
Read docs/remote.md. The iPhone ships separately: omit new optional input keys.
Run npm run export:provider-models after a catalogue change. Read docs/providers.md.
A visual change ships light and dark screenshots: npm run verify -- launcher writes them under .verify/runs/. Read docs/styling.md. A visual-design request gets 3 mockups before code.
Read docs/chat-cards.md. A new event type must pass isConversationVisible in lib/sessionConversationModel.ts. The phone mirrors chat rules: update ios/ in the same change.
Read docs/ios-performance.md. Type goes through Sources/Design/Typography.swift. The phone ships separately from the Mac build.

generatedInputs.text: Rust command changed: run npm run generate:contracts.
A specta type may have changed: run npm run generate:bindings.
A field with a digit before letters needs #[serde(rename = "...")]: serde and specta split it differently.
